{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":8,"lineType":2,"content":"臣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"等謹案：葬書一卷，舊本題晉郭璞撰。璞有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"爾雅註，已著録。葬地之説，莫知其所自來。周","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"官冡人、墓大夫之職，稱皆以族葬，是三代以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"上葬不擇地之明證。漢書藝文志形法家以","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"宮宅地形與相人、相物之書並列，則其數自","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7637341161178284086"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"漢始明，然尚未專言葬法也。後漢書袁安傳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"載安父沒，訪求葬地，道逢三書生，指一處，當","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"世為上公。安從之，故累世貴盛。是其術盛傳","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"於東漢以後。其特以是擅名者，則璞為最著。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"考璞本傳載璞從河東郭公受青囊中書九","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"卷，遂洞天文、五行、卜筮之術。璞門人趙載嘗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"竊青囊書，為火所焚，不言其嘗著葬書。唐末","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"有葬書地脈經一卷、葬書五隂一卷，又不言","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteId {"lines":[{"lineId":"7","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣即一元運行之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169539123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":11,"lineType":1,"content":"在天則周流六虚，在地則發","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169555507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"生萬物。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169555507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"天無此則氣無以資，地無此則形無以載。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169571891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":13,"lineType":1,"content":"故","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169588275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":15,"lineType":1,"content":"磅礴乎大化，貫通乎品彚，無處無之，而無時不運也。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169588275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618851849182249003"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"陶侃曰：先天地而長存，後天地而固有。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169604659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":19,"lineType":1,"content":"蓋亦指此云","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169621043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"耳。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169621043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":21,"lineType":1,"content":"且夫生氣藏于地中，人不可見，惟循地之理以求","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169637427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"之，然後能知其所在。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169637427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":23,"lineType":1,"content":"葬者能知其所在，使枯骨得以","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169653811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":25,"lineType":1,"content":"乗之，則地理之能事畢矣。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169653811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"30","lineNum":39,"lineType":1,"content":"父母骸骨為子孫之本，子孫形體迺父母之枝，一氣","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169768499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"相廕，由本而逹枝也。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169768499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":41,"lineType":1,"content":"故程子曰：卜其宅兆，卜其地之","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169784883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"美惡也。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169784883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"地美則神靈安，子孫盛。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169801267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":43,"lineType":1,"content":"若培壅其根而枝葉","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169817651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"茂，理固然也。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169817651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"惡則反是。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169834035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":45,"lineType":1,"content":"蔡季通曰：生死殊途，情氣相","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169850419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"感，自然黙與之通。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169850419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":47,"lineType":1,"content":"今尋暴骨，以生人刺血滴之而滲","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169866803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"入，則為親骨肉，不滲則非。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169866803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"氣類相感，有如此者。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169883187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":49,"lineType":1,"content":"則知","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169899571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":51,"lineType":1,"content":"枯骨得廕，生人受福，其理顯然，不待智者而後知也。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169899571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618851849182281771"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":55,"lineType":1,"content":"或謂抱養既成，元非遺體，僧道嗣續，亦異所生，其何","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169915955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"能廕之有？","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169915955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":57,"lineType":1,"content":"而不知人之心通乎氣，心為氣之主，情通","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169932339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"則氣亦通，義絶則廕亦絶。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169932339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":59,"lineType":1,"content":"故後母能廕前母子，前母","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169948723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"亦發後母兒。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969169948723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":61,"lineType":1,"content":"其在物則蔞藪螟蛉之𩔖是也，尚何疑焉？","logicSentenceId":"7666015969239629834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"54","lineNum":65,"lineType":1,"content":"父母子孫，本同一氣，互相感召，如受鬼福，故天下名","logicSentenceId":"7666015969239662602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"墓，在在有之。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969239662602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":67,"lineType":1,"content":"葢真龍發迹，迢迢百里，或數十里，結為","logicSentenceId":"7666015969239678986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"一穴。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969239678986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":69,"lineType":1,"content":"及至穴前，則峯巒矗擁，衆水𤨔遶，叠嶂層層，獻","logicSentenceId":"7666015969239695370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618851849182298155"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"竒于後。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969239695370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"龍脉抱衛，砂水翕聚。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969239711754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":73,"lineType":1,"content":"形穴既就，則山川之靈","logicSentenceId":"7666015969239728138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"秀，造化之精英，凝結融㑹于其中矣。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969239728138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":75,"lineType":1,"content":"茍盜其精英，竊","logicSentenceId":"7666015969239744522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":77,"lineType":1,"content":"其靈秀，以父母遺骨藏于融㑹之地，由是子孫之心","logicSentenceId":"7666015969239744522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":79,"lineType":1,"content":"寄托于此，因其心之所寄，遂能與之感通，以致福于","logicSentenceId":"7666015969239744522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":81,"lineType":1,"content":"將來也。","logicSente teIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":235,"lineType":1,"content":"穴遼逺，朝山一㸃，在乎雲靄之表，人莫不以八風無","logicSentenceId":"7666015969240760330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":237,"lineType":1,"content":"蔽為嫌，又豈知支壠氣隱若零散，而其深者猶有聚","logicSentenceId":"7666015969240760330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"也，但得横水攔截，使之有止耳。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969240760330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":239,"lineType":1,"content":"此言支壠之氣盛者","logicSentenceId":"7666015969240776714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":241,"lineType":1,"content":"如此。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969240776714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"高壠之葬，潛而弗彰，故深，取其沉氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969240875018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":255,"lineType":1,"content":"平支之葬，露","logicSentenceId":"7666015969240891402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"而弗隱，故淺，取其浮氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969240891402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":257,"lineType":1,"content":"得乗者，言所葬之棺，得以","logicSentenceId":"7666015969240907786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"乗其生氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969240907786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":259,"lineType":1,"content":"淺深，世俗多用九星白法以定尺寸，謬","logicSentenceId":"7666015969240924170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969240924170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":261,"lineType":1,"content":"不若只依金銀爐㡳求之為得。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969240940554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"214","lineNum":263,"lineType":1,"content":"夫隂陽之氣，噫而為風，升而為雲，降而為雨，行乎地中","logicSentenceId":"7666015969240956938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":265,"lineType":1,"content":"而為生氣。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969240956938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"216","lineNum":267,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽之氣，即地中之生氣，故噫為風，升為雲，降為雨。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969240973322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852167264272425"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"凡所以位天地、育萬物者，何莫非此氣邪？","logicSentenceId":"7666015969240989706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":271,"lineType":1,"content":"斯蓋因曰","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241006090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"葬乗生氣，故重舉以申明其義。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241006090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":273,"lineType":1,"content":"愚嘗謂能生能殺，皆","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241022474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"此氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241022474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"葬得其法，則為生氣；失其道，則為殺氣。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241038858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":275,"lineType":1,"content":"如所","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241055242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":277,"lineType":1,"content":"謂加減饒借、吞吐浮沉之類，並當依法而剪裁之，不","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241055242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":279,"lineType":1,"content":"致有撞殺、沖刑、破腮翻鬬之患也。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241055242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"227","lineNum":281,"lineType":1,"content":"夫土者，氣之體，有土斯有氣；氣者水之母，有氣斯有水。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241071626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"氣本無體，假土為體，因土而知有此氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241088010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"229","lineNum":283,"lineType":1,"content":"水本無母，","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241104394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"假氣為母，因氣而知有此水也。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241104394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":285,"lineType":1,"content":"五行以天一生水，且","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241120778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852167264288809"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"水何從生哉？","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241120778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"生水者，金也；生金者，土也。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241137162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":289,"lineType":1,"content":"土腹藏金，無","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241153546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"質而有其氣。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241153546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"乾藏坤內，隱而未見。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241169930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":291,"lineType":1,"content":"及乎生水，其兆始","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241186314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"萌。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241186314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"言氣為水母者，即乾金之氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241202698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":293,"lineType":1,"content":"世人不究本源，但","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241219082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":295,"lineType":1,"content":"以所見者水爾，故遂以水為天地之始，蓋通而未精","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241219082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":297,"lineType":1,"content":"者也。","logicSentenceId":"7666015969241219082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852167264305193"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":307,"lineType":1,"content":"夫氣行乎地中，其行也，因地之勢；其聚也，因勢之止。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741729779758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"氣行地中，人不可見。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741729796142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":309,"lineType":1,"content":"其始也，則因地之勢而知其行；","logicSentenceId":"7666016741729812526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"253","lineNum":311,"lineType":1,"content":"其次也，又因勢之止而知其聚也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741729812526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"255","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"善葬者，必原其起以觀勢，乗其止以扦穴。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741729845294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":315,"lineType":1,"content":"凡言止者，","logicSentenceId":"7666016741729861678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"乃山川融結竒秀之所有，非明眼莫能識也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741729861678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":317,"lineType":1,"content":"片玉髓","logicSentenceId":"7666016741729878062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"云：草上露華偏在尾，花中香味總居心。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741729878062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":319,"lineType":1,"content":"其止之謂與？","logicSentenceId":"7666016741729894446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":321,"lineType":1,"content":"或謂粘穴乗其脉之盡處為止，然則葢、𠋣、撞安可以","logicSentenceId":"7666016741729910830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852167264321577"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"止云？","logicSentenceId":"7666016741729910830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":325,"lineType":1,"content":"不知古人正恐後世不識止處，故立為四法以","logicSentenceId":"7666016741729927214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"乗之。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741729927214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"夫葢者，止于葢；𠋣者，止于𠋣也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741729943598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":327,"lineType":1,"content":"撞、粘莫不皆然。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741729959982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":329,"lineType":1,"content":"唯觀義之所在，高低正側，何徃而 ":1,"content":"識粘葬山麓，莫不以前拖平地為裀褥，豈知其勢未","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731057710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":501,"lineType":1,"content":"住，兩邉界水，隨脉而行，平平隱伏，直至堂心，其脉始","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731057710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852167264485417"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"盡。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731057710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":505,"lineType":1,"content":"天寳經曰：凡認脉情，看住絶水，若行時脉不歇，歇","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731074094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"時須有小明堂，氣止水交方是穴。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731074094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":507,"lineType":1,"content":"後面要金氣可乘，","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731090478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"前頭要合水可洩。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731090478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":509,"lineType":1,"content":"若還鑿腦而鑿胸，湊急傷龍匪融","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731106862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"結，此定穴之宻語也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731106862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":511,"lineType":1,"content":"故當求其砂水㑹處，枕毬而葬。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731123246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":513,"lineType":1,"content":"隂者為强，固當縮下，奈何性緩，要挿上七八寸，急其","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731139630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"緩性，名為湊交鬬煞。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731139630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":515,"lineType":1,"content":"劉氏所謂擺緩則入簷而湊毬","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731156014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731156014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":517,"lineType":1,"content":"茍執壠法扦之，則主敗絶，此又高隴之至難體","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731172398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":519,"lineType":1,"content":"認者。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731172398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"410","lineNum":525,"lineType":1,"content":"言生氣之所從來，因其來而知其止，故葬者得以乗","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731205166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"之，不使有分寸之違也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731205166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":527,"lineType":1,"content":"脉不離棺，棺不離脉，棺脉相","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731221550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"就，剝花接木。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731221550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":529,"lineType":1,"content":"法當就化生腦上，循脉看下，詳認雞跡","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731237934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":531,"lineType":1,"content":"蠏眼，三文名字，交牙滴斷，或分十字，或不分十字，看","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731237934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":533,"lineType":1,"content":"他隂陽配與不配，及夫强弱順逆，急緩生死，浮沉虚","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731237934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":535,"lineType":1,"content":"實，以定加減饒借，內接生氣，外揚穢氣，內外符合，前","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731237934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"後無蔽，始為眞穴。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731237934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"一有不順，即花假矣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731254318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":537,"lineType":1,"content":"此乗生氣之","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731270702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852167264518185"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":541,"lineType":1,"content":"要訣也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731270702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":541,"lineType" {"lines":[{"lineId":"425","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"謂入首廢壞，眞偽莫辨，故不得不詳加審察也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731319854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":545,"lineType":1,"content":"夫天","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731336238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"眞未䘮，則定穴易為力，但乗其來，即知其止。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731336238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":547,"lineType":1,"content":"却有一","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731352622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":549,"lineType":1,"content":"等不幸，為牛羊踐踏，上破下崩，歲久年深，或種作開","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731352622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":551,"lineType":1,"content":"墾，或前人謬扞其旁，園墻拜壇，不無晦蝕；或曽為居","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731352622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":553,"lineType":1,"content":"基，益低損高；或田家取土，鋤掘𢦤賊，而大八字與金","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731352622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"魚不可得而移易。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731352622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":555,"lineType":1,"content":"但要龍眞局正，水淨砂明，當取前","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731369006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852167264534569"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"後左右四應證之，心目相度，酌量開井，無不得矣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731369006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":559,"lineType":1,"content":"葢","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731385390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":561,"lineType":1,"content":"夫一氣化生，支壠隨炁而成形質，今既廢壊莫辨，故","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731385390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":563,"lineType":1,"content":"必於廢中審之，則凡所謂隂陽剛柔，急緩生死，浮沉","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731385390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"虚實之理，無不瞭然。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741731385390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":565,"lineType":1,"content":"既得其理，則倒杖之法，亦因之","logicSentenceId":"7666016741796872243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":567,"lineType":1,"content":"而定焉。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741796872243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"443","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"謂審擇其所相輔于我者。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741796905011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":571,"lineType":1,"content":"法當于小八字下，看兩肩","logicSentenceId":"7666016741796921395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":573,"lineType":1,"content":"暗翊，肩高肩低，以分隂陽作用；次視三分三合，崎急","logicSentenceId":"7666016741796921395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852167264550953"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":577,"lineType":1,"content":"平緩，以别順逆饒減；盡觀蟬翊之砂、蝦鬚之水，以定","logicSentenceId":"7666016741796921395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"葬口界限。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741796921395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":579,"lineType":1,"content":"是皆左右之所相，茍失其道，則有破腮翻","logicSentenceId":"7666016741796937779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":581,"lineType":1,"content":"鬬、傷龍傷穴、傷淺傷深之患，故不得不詳加審擇也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741796937779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":583,"lineType":1,"content":"下篇言相水印木，義同。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741796954163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"453","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"謂避去死氣，以求生氣也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741796986931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":587,"lineType":1,"content":"葢穴中之氣，有刑有徳，裁","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797003315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":589,"lineType":1,"content":"剪得法，則為生氣；一失其道，則為死氣，故不得不審","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797003315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"而避之。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797003315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"何以言之？","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797019699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"避死挨生是也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797036083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":591,"lineType":1,"content":"如陽脉落穴，以隂","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797052467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852167264567337"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"為生，陽為死；隂脉落穴，以陽為生，隂為死。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797052467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":595,"lineType":1,"content":"脉來邉厚","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797068851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"邊薄，以薄為生，厚為死。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797068851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":597,"lineType":1,"content":"𩀱脉一長一短，以短為生，長","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797085235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":599,"lineType":1,"content":"為死；一大一小，以小為生，大為死；以秀嫩光淨、圓厚","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797085235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"湧動為生，枯老臃腫、破碎直硬為死。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797085235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":601,"lineType":1,"content":"又或砂水之間，","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797101619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"反𠿕斜飛，直撞刺射，皆為形煞。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797101619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":603,"lineType":1,"content":"橫過之山，如鎗如刀，","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797118003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"尖利順水，可收拾為用者用之，可避去者避之。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797118003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":605,"lineType":1,"content":"此則","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797134387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"以眼前之所見者而論之也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797134387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":607,"lineType":1,"content":"又程子謂五患，劉氏謂","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797150771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":609,"lineType":1,"content":"四惡，皆在所當避也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797150771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"古歌曰：若還差一指，如隔萬重山。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797445683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":659,"lineType":1,"content":"良","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797462067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":661,"lineType":1,"content":"有以也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016741797462067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

,"logicSentenceId":"7666016742310150182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"970","lineNum":1293,"lineType":1,"content":"氣為水母，有氣斯有水。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742310182950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":1293,"lineType":1,"content":"原其所始，水之流行，實生氣","logicSentenceId":"7666016742310199334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852167265206313"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"之所為也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742310199334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":1297,"lineType":1,"content":"生氣升而為雲，降而為雨，山川妙用，流行","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560235547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":1299,"lineType":1,"content":"變化，勢若循𤨔，無有窮已。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560235547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":1299,"lineType":1,"content":"是故山之與水，當相體用，","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560251931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"977","lineNum":1301,"lineType":1,"content":"不可須㬰離也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560251931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"979","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"派者，水之分也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560284699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"朝者，水之合也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560301083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":1305,"lineType":1,"content":"夫水之行，初分懸溜，","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560317467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":1307,"lineType":1,"content":"始于一線之微，此水之未盛也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560317467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":1307,"lineType":1,"content":"小流合大流，乃漸逺","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560333851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"984","lineNum":1309,"lineType":1,"content":"而漸多，而至于㑹流總瀦者，此水之大旺也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560333851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":1309,"lineType":1,"content":"葢水之","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560350235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":1311,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹，由山之止，山之始，乃水之起。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560350235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":1311,"lineType":1,"content":"能知水之大㑹，則知","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560366619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852167265222697"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":1315,"lineType":1,"content":"山之大盡。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560366619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":1315,"lineType":1,"content":"推其所始，究其所終，離其所分，合其所聚，","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560383003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":1317,"lineType":1,"content":"置之心目之間，胸臆之内，總而思之，則大小無從而","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560383003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"992","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"逃，地理可貫而盡矣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560383003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":1319,"lineType":1,"content":"若夫禹貢之載九州，其大要則","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560399387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"994","lineNum":1321,"lineType":1,"content":"係于隨山𤀹川之四字。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560399387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":1321,"lineType":1,"content":"如導沇水、導河、導漾之𩔖，皆","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560415771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":1323,"lineType":1,"content":"水之未盛也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560415771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":1323,"lineType":1,"content":"如入于江，入于河，入于海者，皆水之大","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560432155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":1325,"lineType":1,"content":"旺也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560432155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":1325,"lineType":1,"content":"以其大勢言之，則山川之起于西北，自一而生","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560448539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"萬也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560448539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"水之聚于東南，合萬而歸一也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560464923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":1327,"lineType":1,"content":"禹貢舉天下之","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560481307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":1329,"lineType":1,"content":"大者而言之，則始于近而終于逺，自一里而至十里，","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560481307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852167265239081"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":1333,"lineType":1,"content":"由十里而至于足跡之所能及，推其山之起止，究其","logicSentenceId":"7666016742560481307 {"lines":[{"lineId":"1261","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852167265583145"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1262","lineNum":1711,"lineType":1,"content":"憑見在之福，恃當今之勢，富貴之家，自謂常如今日，","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821527579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1263","lineNum":1713,"lineType":1,"content":"而不深慮。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821527579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1264","lineNum":1713,"lineType":1,"content":"有父母之喪者，不思盡力以求宜隱之地，","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821543963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1265","lineNum":1715,"lineType":1,"content":"但茍焉窀變而已。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821543963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1266","lineNum":1715,"lineType":1,"content":"正程子之所謂唯欲掩其目之不","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821560347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1267","lineNum":1717,"lineType":1,"content":"見，反以隂陽之理為無足","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821576731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1268","lineNum":1717,"lineType":2,"content":"缺，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1269","lineNum":1717,"lineType":1,"content":"可勝道哉！","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821576731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1270","lineNum":1717,"lineType":1,"content":"魏","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821593115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1271","lineNum":1719,"lineType":1,"content":"志：管輅遇征東將軍母丘儉之墓，嘆曰：松栢雖茂，無","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821593115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1272","lineNum":1721,"lineType":1,"content":"形可文。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821593115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1273","lineNum":1721,"lineType":1,"content":"碑諡雖美，無後可守。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821609499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1274","lineNum":1721,"lineType":1,"content":"玄武垂頭，青龍無足，白","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821625883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1275","lineNum":1723,"lineType":1,"content":"虎銜屍，朱雀悲泣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821625883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1276","lineNum":1723,"lineType":1,"content":"四危已備，去當滅族。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821642267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1277","lineNum":1723,"lineType":1,"content":"後果如其言。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821658651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1278","lineNum":1725,"lineType":1,"content":"又左氏春秋傳㑹文公十三年，邾文公卜遷于繹，史","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821675035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1279","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852167265599529"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1280","lineNum":1729,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：利于民，不利于君。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821675035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1281","lineNum":1729,"lineType":1,"content":"公曰：茍利于民，孤之利也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821691419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1282","lineNum":1729,"lineType":1,"content":"左右","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821707803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1283","lineNum":1731,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：命可長也，君何弗為？","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821707803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1284","lineNum":1731,"lineType":1,"content":"公曰：命在養民，民茍利矣，遷","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821724187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1285","lineNum":1733,"lineType":1,"content":"也，吉莫如之。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821724187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1286","lineNum":1733,"lineType":1,"content":"遂遷。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821740571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1287","lineNum":1733,"lineType":1,"content":"五月，公果卒。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821756955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1288","lineNum":1733,"lineType":1,"content":"然固有數焉，而隂陽","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821773339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1289","lineNum":1735,"lineType":1,"content":"之理，亦有所定矣。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821773339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1301","lineNum":1755,"lineType":1,"content":"上言天時人事不能全美，或有吉地吉穴，主人濡滯","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821871643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1302","lineNum":1757,"lineType":1,"content":"不葬，或是非爭競而害成，或貧病兼憂而不能舉，或","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821871643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1303","lineNum":1759,"lineType":1,"content":"明師老死不復再來，或停喪久逺而兵火不測，或子","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821871643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1304","lineNum":1761,"lineType":1,"content":"孫叅差而人事不齊，或官事牢獄而不復可為，或日","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821871643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1305","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7618852167265632297"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1306","lineNum":1765,"lineType":1,"content":"怠日忘竟成𣓪置，或全家絶滅同歸暴露。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821871643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1307","lineNum":1765,"lineType":1,"content":"是皆因葬","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821888027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1308","lineNum":1767,"lineType":1,"content":"不即舉，而變見多端也。","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821888027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1309","lineNum":1767,"lineType":1,"content":"嗚呼！","logicSentenceId":"7666016742821904411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1310","lineNum":1767,"lineType":1,"content":"為人者可不凛凛然而","logicSentenceId":"7666016742916751386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1311","lineNum":1769,"lineType":1,"content":"知戒謹乎哉！","logicSentenceId":"7666016742916751386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
